name: SVC_MCA_CALL_FLOW_CONFIG
description: This table is used to store the MCA Call Flow Configuration data.

columns.name: CALL_FLOW_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates this is the row which should be used by default.  This also will have a null channel and application classification.

columns.name: APPL_CLASSIFICATION_CD
columns.description: The application classification derived from the lookup type ORA_SVC_MCA_APPL_CLASSIF_CD

columns.name: WRAP_UP_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The wrap up page type derived from the lookup type ORA_SVC_MCA_WRAP_UP_TYPE_CD

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the SVC_CHANNEL table.

columns.name: CONTACT_REQD_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating if a contact is required.

columns.name: SCREEN_POPUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the Screen Pop should be used.

columns.name: WRAP_UP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the Wrap up should be performed.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).
